name: dumbbell-step-up.html
instructions:
1. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, keeping your arms fully extended by your sides.
2. Place a sturdy bench or platform in front of you, about knee height, and stand with your feet hip-width apart, facing the step. This is the starting position.
3. Place one foot on the step, pressing through your heel to lift your body upward.
4. Push through the working foot on the step to fully extend your leg and bring your other foot up to the platform.
5. Once both feet are on the platform, step down with your non-working foot, followed by the other foot.
6. Alternate legs for each rep, or complete all reps on one leg before switching.
